lines.0: Namaste Riya, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum number line par fractions rakhenge. Aapko drawing banana pasand hai?
lines.1: Aapne chhidiya, flowers aur peacock banaya—peacock ka tedha pankh bhi drawing ka apna style hai. Main AI hoon; chaliye: Bittu ko end mein sikhayenge.
lines.2: Aap sahi keh rahi hain—number line drawing jaisi hai; AI drawing waali baat end mein. 0 se 1 ko paanch equal gaps kijiye; pehla nishaan kis fraction ka hoga?
lines.3: Haan, line kheenchkar equal points mark karna bilkul drawing jaisa hai—ab aap apna fraction wala thought poora kijiye.
lines.4: Aapko fractions boring lag rahe hain—abhi triangle-game karte hain: screen ki number line ko triangle ki base samajhkar equal marks lagaiye. Pehla mark kahan ho
lines.5: Chaliye game: number line par target 11/10 hai. Pehle 0 se 1 ke beech kitne equal gaps banenge—ruler se mark kijiye.
lines.6: Aapne denominator ka rule pakda: 0 se 1 tak 5 equal gaps. Screen par 2/5 ke liye doosra mark kahan hoga?
lines.7: Aapne doosra mark sahi chuna. Geometry ke liye triangle banaiye: teen sides mein se do sides barabar hon, toh triangle ka naam kya hoga?
lines.8: Aap sahi keh rahi hain, Riya—maine game ka track badal diya. Mark 2/5 on a number line from 0 to 1. Khaali jagah bhariye: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because
lines.9: Haan, isosceles triangle mein do sides equal hoti hain. Aap uski equal sides ko ruler se naapkar drawing mein clearly mark kijiye. Mark 2/5 on a number line fro
lines.10: Aap theek keh rahi hain, Riya. Ab triangle par hi rahenge: isosceles triangle ki equal sides koek jaise tick marks se dikhaiye. Mark 2/5 on a number line from 0
